worldcombat.skill.assist.summary: Calls nearby allies for help and randomly borrows one of the moves they have learned.
worldcombat.skill.assist.use.1: Borrow one ally move at random
worldcombat.skill.assist.description.0: After calling for %1$s it borrows and performs one random move known by an ally inside the call radius; it does not fire when no ally answers.
worldcombat.skill.assist.description.1: The call radius is %1$s, and the borrowed move cannot reach farther than %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.assist.description.2: Current call radius setting: %1$s. Calling farther covers more allies but takes longer.
worldcombat.skill.assist.preference.call: Higher hears farther allies and widens the pool, but the shout takes longer; lower acts faster but may find nothing when alone or spread out.
